Question 9
?

Which integral gives the area of the finite region bounded by y=4x2−x and y=2−x2−4x?

a
∫−12/5(−5x2−3x+2)dx
b
∫−12/5(4x2−x)dx
c
∫−52(4x2−x)dx
d
∫−52(2−x2−4x)dx
e
∫−12/5(2−x2−4x)dx
